PARTY_HAT_SLOTH_CHEEKY |rarity = special |source = [[Simon]] |upgradeable = no |auctionable = yes |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special }} The '''Sloth Hat of Celebration''' is a {{Special}} [[Hatcessory]] that was given out during the 4th [[SkyBlock Anniversaries|SkyBlock Anniversary]]. == Obtaining == The '''Sloth Hat of Celebration''' was distributed by {{NPCSprite|Simon}} during the 4th [[SkyBlock Anniversary|{{Pink|SkyBlock Anniversary}}]] in front of the [[Bazaar]]. === Game Message === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Message |- | class="ct" | Collecting Sloth Hat |{{Dialogue|&aYou claimed a &7[Expression]&c Sloth Hat of Celebration&a!}} |- | class="ct" |Another player collects Sloth Hat |{{Dialogue|&eSimon gave a &7[Expression]&c Sloth Hat of Celebration&e to &7&e!}} |- | class="ct" | Attempting to claim another Sloth Hat |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Simon: &fI've already given you a Sloth Hat for this year! Happy Anniversary!}} |} == Usage == {{:Hatcessories/Effect}} ==Trivia== *The expression of the hat was randomly selected when it was claimed, like the color of [[Century Cake]] and [[Crab Hat of Celebration]]. *The Grumpy expression is a reference to Grumpy Cat, a popular meme from the 2010's. * Players could only acquire a Sloth Hat on one [[profile]]. *The Sloth Hats, [[Crab Hat of Celebration|Crab Hats]], and the [[Pulse Ring]] are the only [[Accessory|Accessories]] that give {{stat|mf}} without [[Enrichments]]. *The amount of {{stat|int}} gained depends only on the number of [[Time|SkyBlock years]] that have passed since the player created their oldest profile, regardless of the player's activity during this time. The current maximum, which applies to players who joined during the first SkyBlock year, is {{SkyClock}}. * Despite one of Hypixel's owners being associated with sloths, this is the first Sloth themed item in the game. * [[Hatccessory|Hatccessories]] are inconsistent with their names. The 2022 Crab Hats are the only Hatcessories specifying their year of origin in their title. Crab Hats and Sloth Hats are said to be "of Celebration", while the Balloon Hats are "Anniversary". * Sloth Hats come in 10 variants, while every other [[Hatcessory|Hatcessories]] only has 9. == Gallery ==
